expected_differences: Search uses a compact operational list rather than the Lab’s discovery ribbon and vehicle shelf; no decorative source-to-commitment offset is needed here.
The real query returns 5 open campaigns, 3 businesses and 7 people. Preserve their stored names, including existing '[demo]' text, rather than substituting Lab fixtures.
Business initials are appropriate where records lack photographs; replacement portraits or generated media are unnecessary.
Cars and monthly asking prices are correctly absent because vehicles are private and not searchable.
The captured Personal account legitimately has different navigation from the Lab’s business account, but it does not demonstrate the targeted business-context fix.
keep: The 200px graphite rail, restrained TapMart lockup, mineral canvas and 32px main gutter match the approved system.
The 36/40px page title, strong section headings, ink result titles and muted metadata create a clear operational hierarchy.
Keep the single query field, visible clear control, full-size cobalt Search button and separated cobalt focus outline.
Keep the open result rows, thin dividers, restrained thumbnail corners and rounded business initials; do not introduce cards or shadows.
Keep literal Open status text, muted group counts and the selected Search navigation edge.
review.readiness_note: The visible Personal Search screen passes visual review, but hold the targeted business-mode sign-off. The selector reads Personal and the rail shows Activity, Earnings and Profile. Capture Search at 1440×900 after navigating from a selected real business and refreshing, confirming that the business identity and navigation remain intact. This is a verification gap, not proof that the Personal screen is broken; search submission, result navigation and clear behavior also require interaction testing.
review.why: The visible treatment faithfully carries Frame Shift into a utility screen: mineral working surface, graphite confined to navigation, cobalt concentrated on the primary action, focus and selection, and flat result groups without theatrical media or generic card containers. Campaign titles, business provenance and literal statuses remain readable and distinct. The People group beginning near the viewport bottom is normal vertical continuation, not missing functionality. No implementation drift is established by these pixels. However, this Personal-context capture cannot substantiate the specific pass-3 claim that business context survives navigation to Search.
review.verdict: Frame Shift is faithfully transferred to the visible Personal Search interface, but release sign-off for the targeted business-context fix needs the corresponding business-mode capture.
